title: The Prognostic Value of FDG PET/CT and Diffusion-weighed Imaging on Breast Cancer
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine findings of positron emission tomography and diffusion weighted magnetic resonance in primary lesion and axillary metastasis of breast cancer and compare of two imaging modality in these patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Newly diagnosis of breast cancer for which surgical intervention is planned

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients received neoadjuvant chemotherapy
* before breast surgery
